method: Unchanged original classes on the HorseProbe/MobMoveProbe world double (tools/probes/ProjectileNbtProbe.java). Each projectile is built with its constructor at (100.5, 64, -20.25) with motion (0.25, -0.5, 1), yaw 37.5, pitch -12.25, and saved with Entity.writeToNBTOptional (sa.c; false for a class without an EntityList id). Named keys of that tag are edited ("in" is the edited tag) and it is loaded with EntityList.createEntityFromNBT (sg.a). nbt is the loaded entity saved again (uncompressed hex); the other fields are its Entity fields.
